# Branches whose pull requests may close into the default branch.
#
# This list is the repository's claim about itself, and `merge-gate`
# (xtask/tools/src/merge_gate.rs) reads it on every pull request that targets
# the default branch. A head branch that is not named here is denied, so the
# list is the whole permission: there is no wildcard, no prefix match and no
# "same repository is enough".
#
# Why it is a file and not a condition in the workflow: the workflow that runs
# the gate is what the protected branch requires, so the rule it applies has to
# be reviewable as a diff, not as an expression inside the thing being gated.
#
# Measured 2026-11-27: branch protection on `consensus-of-consensuses` required
# the context `merge-block-default-branch` and no workflow produced it, so the
# delivery pull request sat blocked with every other check green. The gate that
# produces it now reads this file.
testnet-50
ortak-teslim
